summary: Verified registration error-toast fix on /register + regression on /login. Both frontend and backend behave correctly. Duplicate email returns 400 with string detail 'Email already registered' rendered as-is. Pydantic 422 array detail is now joined into a human-readable string ('String should have at least 6 characters') — no [object Object]. Patient and doctor self-registration succeed and redirect to their dashboards. Admin login regression passes.
passed: Backend POST /api/auth/register duplicate email -> HTTP 400 {detail:'Email already registered'}
Backend POST /api/auth/register password<6 -> HTTP 422 with detail as array (Pydantic)
Frontend /register duplicate email (admin@healthtwin.ai) -> toast 'Email already registered' (string, no [object Object], no fallback 'Registration failed')
Frontend /register short password bypass -> toast 'String should have at least 6 characters' (array joined, no [object Object])
notes: Admin role is intentionally absent from /register role picker — only patient/doctor offered, as documented. Users trying to 'register' admin@healthtwin.ai should instead sign in with seeded creds; the toast now clearly says 'Email already registered' making this discoverable.
